title: Adaptive turn-amalgamator for streaming chat: KV pressure balancing and GPU slab hysteresis
creator: Priya Nair
description: Design and implement an adaptive turn-amalgamation heuristic for continuous batching in streaming chat completions that balances KV cache pressure and GPU slab allocation. Goal is to increase effective batch sizes for throughput without regressing tail latency or blowing up KV eviction rates. This ticket covers algorithm design, config surface, implementation in the batch planner, and an experiment plan to validate P95/P99 latency, GPU memory use, and per-token cost.
acceptance_criteria: New 'turn-amalgamator' mode integrated into stream batch planner behind a feature flag
P95 latency for streaming completions does not increase by more than 10% versus baseline under typical production traffic patterns
KV cache eviction rate reduces or stays within 5% of baseline while average batch size increases by >= 15% in mixed-workload tests
GPU slab fragmentation decreases (measured by avg contiguous free slab bytes) and memory spikes avoided during bursty sessions
End-to-end canary rollout and automatic fallback to legacy microbatcher on SLA breach
Comprehensive telemetry dashboards and alerts added: batch-size distribution, kv-pressure-signal, slab-hysteresis-events
implementation_notes: Introduce 'kv_pressure' signal derived from KV hit ratio, eviction-rate, and recent prefetch queue length. Smooth with EWMA (alpha=0.2) to avoid oscillation.

Turn-amalgamator heuristic: when kv_pressure < low_threshold and GPU_free_slab > slab_reserve, allow coalescing of concurrent turns up to dynamic_turn_cap; when kv_pressure > high_threshold, prioritize small eager emits and prefetch KV slots for high-priority sessions.
Dynamic_turn_cap computed per-GPU per-window: base_cap * (1 + beta * (1 - kv_pressure)) * session_priority_factor. beta tunable (start 0.5).

GPU slab hysteresis: two thresholds for expand/contract to prevent flip-flopping. Expand if free_slab_ratio > 0.35 for N consecutive windows, contract if free_slab_ratio < 0.18 for M windows. N=3, M=2 (experiment).
Partial-emit safety: for streaming flows with strict latency SLO, allow early partial emission when head_token_wait > latency_budget/2 irrespective of amalgamation state.
KV prefetch budget: assign per-session prefetch budget proportional to recent successful hits; throttle prefetch during high pressure windows.
Fallback: implement deterministic fallback to session-aware microbatcher (ENG-62041 compatible) when P99 latency crosses SLA or when uncaught exceptions occur in planner path.
Config knobs exposed in runtime config and Redwood Console: kv_low_thresh, kv_high_thresh, beta, slab_reserve, expand_window, contract_window, dynamic_turn_cap_max, feature_flag_turn_amalgamator.
Code touches: batch_planner service, runtime config schema, heuristics module, telemetry emission, unit/integration tests. Add feature flag gating and a runtime experiment predicate.
rollout_plan: Merge behind feature flag and run internal unit/integration tests in CI
Shadow rollout on dedicated canary pool for 48h with telemetry validation (no traffic shift)
Open A/B experiment targeting 5% of streaming traffic with gradual ramp to 25% if metrics stable
Monitor P95/P99 latency, kv_eviction_rate, avg_batch_size, slab_free_ratio for 72h
If regressions observed, hot-fix thresholds or rollback feature flag; automatic rollback if P99 > baseline * 1.25 for > 10 minutes
Full rollout to region after 1 week of stable metrics and sign-off from SRE and PM
tests: Unit tests for EWMA smoothing and kv_pressure derivation
Deterministic simulation harness reproducing mixed-burst chat workload (short Q/A, long conversations, background embedding calls)
Integration test that runs planner with synthetic KV hit/eviction traces and asserts no memory spike > 95th historical
Canary run with real traffic and injected high-kv-pressure events to validate fallback
Chaos test that kills a GPU slab and ensures planner redistributes batches and triggers hysteresis behavior
blockers: Need finalized contract on session priority factors from PM
GPU slab telemetry currently missing contiguous-free-bytes metric in some regions (SRE ticket opened)
